draft_reason: data/report control surfaces were discovered during membrane classification and need one observation cycle before promotion.
promotion_condition: all watched data control files are classified, lint-repo-topology-contract stays green, and report output policy is stable after Git membrane closure wave 4.
purpose: Classify non-data control files under data/report surfaces so report hygiene files do not masquerade as datasets or runtime output.

quarantined.rule: A quarantined data control surface is not data, evidence, or runtime state.
quarantined.exit_condition: delete, move to explicit report hygiene policy, or reclassify after its authority is clear

report_hygiene_control.rule: A report hygiene control file may exist only to keep generated reports out of source truth while curated evidence remains explicit.
report_hygiene_control.exit_condition: keep while report output exists, or delete when reports are promoted, ignored elsewhere, or removed

transitional.rule: A transitional data control surface has unsettled authority between generated output and curated evidence.
transitional.exit_condition: promote to report_hygiene_control, migrate to evidence capsule policy, quarantine, or delete

surfaces.expiry_condition: phase-2.0 report outputs are either fully ignored as runtime reports or promoted into curated evidence manifests
